pamphlet_excerpts: Baskets Plaited Coiled Ribbed: Your counselor that you are able: The following are common weaves used in this pamphlet (p. 11).

Baskets Plaited Coiled Ribbed Principle 2: Your counselor that you are able Principle 2: Sometimes called over-under weave, the plainweave is done with rigid stakes or spokes, and weavers thatwrap around the stakes in an over-one (p. 11).
Baskets Plaited Coiled Ribbed Principle 3: Your counselor that you are able Principle 3: Spokes and stakes usually are more rigid and thicker reedthan weavers (p. 11).
Baskets Plaited Coiled Ribbed Principle 4: Your counselor that you are able Principle 4: Continuous weave looks much the same as plainweave, but it is woven with a different technique (p. 11).
step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 (Baskets Plaited Coiled Ribbed): Step 1 (Your counselor that you are able): This weave is created over an odd number of stakes (p. 11).

Step 2 (Baskets Plaited Coiled Ribbed): Step 2 (Your counselor that you are able): It is not done one row at a time, but continuously from beginning to end, with additional weavers added whenmore length is needed (p. 11).

Step 3 (Baskets Plaited Coiled Ribbed): Step 3 (Your counselor that you are able): This method of weaving involves the weaverpassing over two or more stakes and under two or more stakesat a time (p. 11).

Step 4 (Baskets Plaited Coiled Ribbed): Step 4 (Your counselor that you are able): This weave, sometimes called pairing, involvestwo weavers, each alternately twisting over and underconsecutive spokes (p. 11).
